figure.caption: Human hantavirus case mapping gate: descriptive availability/count panels from public CDC WONDER annual U.S. state data and ECDC country-month surveillance rows. Panels are non-geographic tile maps used in place of licensed boundary geometry. They summarize public aggregate case availability/counts only and must not be interpreted as risk, causal, spillover, or transmission maps.
